critical_limitations_en: The generated eight-file corpus was searched bidirectionally with deterministic structural and lexical indexes, source-specific rows and bounded conjunctive candidates. This is not equivalent to independent manual predicate verification of all 979 atoms.

Phase 2 suppressed some eligible standalone short table cells; the recovered 188 evidence records are added as separately enumerated effective occurrences and classes. These recoveries are explicitly marked and will require Phase 5 semantic and duplicate auditing.
A remaining FN is a conservative coverage adjudication, not a certified absence; both TP and FN may change after independent audit. No four-cell score or FP/TN is asserted in Phase 3.
Source inventory R and N retain Phase 1 IDs and counts; no method-specific denominator change was made.
